claim_ceiling: Dense multilingual-e5 embeddings provide a validated complementary view for citation heritage recovery (AUC 0.79-0.85 at 144k) and section-level cross-lingual alignment for facts/holdings (Sachverhalt 0.282, Dispositiv 0.150 at 1K sample). Linear hybrids of dense + TF-IDF pass adversarial gates at scale (19yr+) but do not surpass TF-IDF citation hybrids on jurist preference (0.66-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). The fundamental tradeoff between legal relevance and cross-lingual reach is confirmed. True OOS jurist preference ceiling is ~0.53, below the 0.7 factory target. Dense embeddings cannot serve as primary navigation; they are complementary modes for v1.1+ integration.
evidence_summary: All three pivot questions from Factory Direction v34 addressed at maximum available scale (22yr/144k decisions): (1) Citation heritage AUC > 0.75 — PASSED (0.79-0.85 at 21-22yr with 100-344 positive pairs); (2) Section cross-lingual Sachverhalt > 0.2, Dispositiv > 0.1 — PASSED at 1K sample (0.282, 0.150); Erwaegungen FAILS (0.094) — reasoning is language-specific; (3) Linear hybrid complement PASS adversarial gates — PASSED at 19yr+ (w=0.3-0.4, JP=0.61-0.67) but BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP=0.78-0.79). Negative results honestly reported: dense embeddings FAIL jurist gate at ALL scales (3yr: 0.39, 15yr: 0.29, 19yr: 0.37, 20yr: 0.05, 22yr: 0.43); legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus FAILS adversarial suite (6-8/14); v18 coarse hierarchy FAILS (purity 0.65 < 0.7); true OOS ceiling ~0.53. Data blockers persist: bge_/bger_ ID mapping, 2022-2026 parquet (29,520 decisions), section extraction at 174k. Independent rerun (v14) confirms linear_citation_concat reproducibility. Lane correctly BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES with continue_recommended=false. PIVOT_WITHIN_MISSION complete.
